Fidelity metrics reflect the exclusion

userStories.notes: VERIFIED CLEAN 2026-06-11, no quarantine needed: paper_trades has ZERO rows in 6/4-6/10 window (RL executor kept in-memory position, never wrote tracker); trade_outcomes sole row is 2026-04-17 MCL (pre-window); IB DUP662235 flat (no residual RL position). Contamination did not persist into any dataset fidelity/calibration reads. Building exclusion machinery for an empty set = dead code; closed with evidence.

userStories.title: Verify + harden dashboard WS real-time path (403 premise was stale)
userStories.description: Original premise (WS upgrade 403s without API key -> dashboard stuck on 5s polling) was STALE: PR #24 (fix/ws-events-403) already fixed it, and APIKeyMiddleware is BaseHTTPMiddleware (http scopes only) so the upgrade is keyless by design. Revised scope: live end-to-end verification + harden the remaining latent traps (localhost IPv6 fallbacks, misleading proxy comments).
acceptanceCriteria: Live e2e proof: real browser on :3010 -> engine /ws/status connections >= 1
No localhost:8010 fallback anywhere in the dashboard WS path (IPv6 pitfall)
Comments no longer claim next start proxies WS upgrades (it does not)
pnpm run build passes
userStories.notes: Verified 2026-06-11: headless Chrome on http://127.0.0.1:3010/ -> /ws/status connections: 1 at t+4s; ws://127.0.0.1:8010/ws/events upgrades 101 keyless with 30s pings. The 06-03 'connections: 0' observation just meant no browser tab was open. Hardening commit 3a42030 (3 files, build green). lib/use-websocket.ts + lib/websocket-example.tsx are dead code (live consumers use hooks/useWebSocket via EngineWebSocketProvider in layout.tsx) -- surfaced for human removal, not deleted.

Root cause: conftest mock_settings = TradingConfig() reads LIVE engine/.env -> ALLOW_PAPER_SIMULATED_ORDERS=True leaked in -> sim path short-circuits _check_gating_conditions to approved -> 3 live-gate tests flip. Pinned False in conftest (sim tests opt in explicitly). 333/333 across all affected families. safety_layer.py untouched.
